critique.evidence: No standard-motion behavior was captured at any viewport: activeAnimationCount, transitionElementCount, and changedElementCount were all 0. Frame delivery was stable—0 long frames, with tablet/mobile worst frames near 16.8 ms and desktop worst at 33.4 ms—but this proves performance, not motion quality. Reduced-motion samples showed no visual changes, yet still reported 1 active animation and transitions on all 57 sampled elements, so reduced-motion implementation is not cleanly demonstrated.
critique.fix: Add and measure purposeful economics-screen transitions or interaction feedback, with before/during/after frames and timing across viewports. Under prefers-reduced-motion, explicitly disable animations and unnecessary transitions so activeAnimationCount and transitionElementCount reach 0 while preserving the final state.
